<reason>B won the hierarchy test. A claimed dignity is vague/coercive, but B redefined it as equal standing that also opposes forced treatment, then forced a conflict case where valid consent remains yet the paid discriminatory sterilization scheme should be banned. A conceded valid consent plus shutdown in A4.1, accepting an independent dignity constraint that outweighs an authorized preference, and the offer vs body reframe did not dissolve that autonomy cost.</reason>
